tools.name: search
tools.description: Search public WeJob jobs, formations, and companies. Returns ids usable with fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch a public WeJob item by id. Supported id prefixes: job:, formation:, company:.

tools.name: wejob_search_jobs
tools.description: Search public active WeJob job offers.

query.description: Free-text search over titles, descriptions, skills, companies and places. Words are OR-ed: one or two keywords work best, e.g. Java or data engineer.

location.description: City or canton, e.g. Genève, Vaud, Lausanne, Zurich. Comma-separate several places.

company.description: Company name filter, e.g. WeJob Sàrl.

skills.description: Comma-separated hard skills, e.g. Java, SQL. Only matches skills listed on the offer: prefer query for a broad search.

languages.description: Comma-separated language filter, for example Anglais, English, en.

employment_type.description: Comma-separated contract or workload: full_time, part_time, CDI, CDD, contract, internship, apprenticeship, freelance. French terms are accepted (temps plein, temps partiel, stage, alternance).

work_mode.description: Comma-separated work mode: on_site, hybrid, remote (sur site, hybride, télétravail are accepted).

experience_level.description: Comma-separated level: junior, intermediate, senior, expert (entry, mid, confirmé, lead are accepted).

categories.description: Comma-separated category names, e.g. Développement & IT.

salary_min.description: Minimum salary as a number, in the offer currency (CHF), e.g. 100000.

salary_max.description: Maximum salary as a number, in the offer currency (CHF), e.g. 140000.

tools.name: wejob_get_job
tools.description: Fetch one public active WeJob job offer by public id (raw id or the job:<id> returned by search/fetch).

query.description: Free-text search over titles, descriptions and programs, e.g. cybersécurité.

location.description: City or canton, e.g. Genève, Vaud, Lausanne, Zurich. Comma-separate several places.

company.description: Company name filter, e.g. WeJob Sàrl.

skills.description: Comma-separated hard skills, e.g. Java, SQL. Only matches skills listed on the offer: prefer query for a broad search.

formation_mode.description: Comma-separated training mode: presentiel, distanciel, hybride (on-site, online, hybrid are accepted).

certification_type.description: Comma-separated certification: certificat, diplome, attestation, bootcamp, aucun (certificate, diploma, none are accepted).

categories.description: Comma-separated category names, e.g. Développement & IT.

tarif_min.description: Minimum price as a number, e.g. 500.

tarif_max.description: Maximum price as a number, e.g. 3000.

tools.name: wejob_get_formation
tools.description: Fetch one public active WeJob formation by public id (raw id or the formation:<id> returned by search/fetch).

query.description: Free-text search over company names and descriptions.

location.description: City or canton, e.g. Genève, Vaud, Lausanne, Zurich. Comma-separate several places.

industries.description: Comma-separated business sectors, e.g. technologies, finance, sante, education, commerce, marketing, consulting, industrie, telecommunications.

tools.name: wejob_get_company
tools.description: Fetch one public WeJob company profile by public id (raw id or the company:<id> returned by search/fetch).
